h: Imo Governor Uzodimma tells Wike the Rainbow Coalition does not exist in his state
p: Imo State Governor Hope Uzodimma has reportedly challenged FCT Minister Nyesom Wike over his Rainbow Coalition, saying it has no presence in Imo. The exchange is the latest in a running dispute between the two over 2027 alignments, with Wike saying the platform is for Tinubu supporters and not an APC structure.
more: Uzodimma chairs the Progressive Governors Forum, which has said its members remain committed to the APC.
Wike has previously said he is backing rival candidates in Imo.
Neither side has shown signs of backing down.
